name: JLCPCB, 2-layer FR-4, 1 oz outer copper
description: Design constraints for the cheapest common JLCPCB process. These are the vendor's stated minimums: a design that passes is manufacturable, not comfortable.

source.citation: JLCPCB, 'Rigid PCB Manufacturing Capabilities', sections PCB Specifications / Drilling / Traces / Legend / Outline. Figures read for 2-layer FR-4 at 1 oz outer copper.

notes.track_min_width: Traces: min. track width and spacing (1 oz), 1- and 2-layer: 0.10 / 0.10 mm (4 / 4 mil).
notes.min_through_drill: Drilling: drill diameter, 2-layer: 0.15 - 6.3 mm. The vendor notes 0.15 mm is 'more costly' and prefers 0.2 mm; this profile permits the stated minimum and leaves the cost judgement to the designer.
notes.vias_min_size: Drilling: min. via hole size / diameter, 2-layer: 0.15 mm hole / 0.25 mm diameter.
notes.hole_to_hole_min: Drilling: pad hole-to-hole spacing 0.45 mm. Via hole-to-hole is looser at 0.2 mm; the stricter figure is applied board-wide.
notes.copper_edge_clearance: Outline, routed: copper clearance from routed board edges >= 0.2 mm.
notes.min_silk_text_height: Legend: minimum text height 40 mil (1.0 mm); below this characters are unidentifiable.

not_encoded: Via annular width: the vendor states PTH annular ring >= 0.20 mm (0.25 mm recommended, 2-layer 1 oz) but does not state a via-specific annular minimum. Deriving one from via diameter minus hole size would be inventing a number, so it is left unset. TODO(source): confirm with the vendor.
NPTH pad annular ring >= 0.45 mm and min. non-plated hole 0.50 mm — KiCad has no board-wide setting for either; they belong in a custom rule file.
Soldermask bridge 0.10 mm and soldermask expansion — vendor-side processing, not a board DRC constraint.
Min. board size 3 x 3 mm, max. dimensions, panelisation — checked by the fab at order time.
